amendments.text:
A horizontal tail balancing load is defined as

that necessary to maintain the airplane in equilibrium in a specified flight condition with zero pitching acceleration. The horizontal tail surfaces shall be designed for the balancing loads occurring at any point on the limit maneuvering envelope, Figure 3-1, and in the flap conditions. (See § 3.190.) Nore: The distribution of Figure 3-7 may be used.
